Title: ORG-01: Organization CRUD (Platform Admin)
Description: Platform Admin CRUD completo para Organizations: listagem paginada, criação, visualização, edição, suspensão/reativação, exclusão (soft delete). Inclui validação de slug único, branding, configurações iniciais.
Checklist: Controller Platform/OrganizationController|Listagem paginada com filtros|Create com validação slug|Show com detalhes|Update branding/settings|Suspend/Activate toggle|Soft delete + restore|Policies: view/update/delete/manageWorkspaces|Testes: Platform Admin only

Title: ORG-02: Organization Settings (branding, domain, timezone, locale)
Description: Settings completos da Organization: branding (logo, cores, favicon), domínio customizado (CNAME), timezone, locale, moeda, configurações de email, features flags por plano.
Checklist: SettingsController (show/update)|Branding upload (logo/favicon)|Domain validation CNAME|Timezone/locale/currency|Feature flags per plan|Email config (SMTP/Resend)|Frontend: OrganizationSettings.vue|Validação multi-tenant

Title: ORG-03: Workspace CRUD (Organization Admin)
Description: Organization Admin CRUD para Workspaces: listagem, criação, edição, exclusão. Workspace herda organization_id, configurações próprias (nome, slug, settings, limits).
Checklist: Controller Organization/WorkspaceController|Listagem workspaces da org|Create com validação slug único|Show/Update/Delete|Workspace herda organization_id|Policies: view/update/delete/manageMembers|Testes: Org Admin only

Title: ORG-04: Workspace Members: Invite, Roles (admin/member/viewer), Remove
Description: Gestão completa de membros do Workspace: convite por email, roles (admin/member/viewer), remoção, reenvio convite, expiração convite (7 dias), aceite de convite.
Checklist: MemberController (invite, resend, remove, updateRole)|Email convite com token assinado|Roles: admin/member/viewer|Convite expira 7 dias|Frontend: MembersTable.vue, InviteModal.vue|Policies: manageMembers|Testes: cross-workspace isolation

Title: ORG-05: Workspace Settings (features, limits, integrations)
Description: Settings do Workspace: features habilitadas (por plano), limits customizados (api_calls, ai_tokens, storage), integrações ativas (WhatsApp, CRM, etc.), configurações de notificação, webhooks.
Checklist: WorkspaceSettingsController|Features toggle per plan|Custom limits override|Integrations management|Notification preferences|Webhook endpoints|Frontend: WorkspaceSettings.vue|Validação tenant

Title: ORG-06: User Profile & Preferences (avatar, locale, timezone, 2FA)
Description: Perfil do usuário logado: avatar upload, nome, telefone, locale, timezone, 2FA (TOTP setup/backup codes), preferências de notificação, sessões ativas, security log.
Checklist: ProfileController (show, update, avatar, 2FA)|Avatar upload (MinIO/S3)|2FA TOTP setup + backup codes|Locale/timezone preferences|Notification preferences|Active sessions management|Security log|Frontend: Profile.vue

Title: ORG-07: Impersonation (Platform Admin → Org Admin → Workspace User)
Description: Impersonation segura: Platform Admin → qualquer Org/User; Org Admin → seus Workspaces/Users; Log completo de auditoria, timeout automático (30min), botão 'Stop Impersonating'.
Checklist: ImpersonateController (start, stop)|Middleware ImpersonateCheck|Audit log: impersonation_started/ended|Timeout 30min auto-stop|UI indicator 'Impersonating as...'|Policies: Platform→all, Org→own ws, WS→none|Testes: security-auditor

Title: ORG-08: Domain/Subdomain routing (custom domains para orgs)
Description: Roteamento por domínio customizado: CNAME validation, SSL automático (Let's Encrypt), fallback para subdomain, middleware de resolução, cache Redis. Suporte a: org.saaspet.com, cliente.com.br.
Checklist: DomainResolver middleware|CNAME validation job|SSL provisioning (Let's Encrypt)|Custom domain config em Organization|Cache Redis TTL 1h|Fallback subdomain|Testes: multi-domain isolation

Title: ORG-09: Organization Onboarding Wizard (multi-step)
Description: Wizard multi-step para nova Organization: 1) Dados básicos (nome, slug), 2) Plano (Free/Starter/Pro/Ent), 3) Branding (logo, cores), 4) Primeiro Workspace, 5) Convidar equipe, 6) Conclusão + redirect para dashboard.
Checklist: OnboardingController (step validation, persistence)|Frontend: OnboardingWizard.vue (5 steps)|Step 1: Basic info|Step 2: Plan selection (Stripe/Paddle)|Step 3: Branding upload|Step 4: First workspace|Step 5: Team invites|Step 6: Complete + redirect|Session storage per step|Validação tenant
